title: What’s In My Bag: A Sony Artisan’s Kit For Kando Trip 2026
summary: See the Sony gear Artisan Tony Gale used to capture community, creativity and unforgettable moments at Kando Trip 2026 in Vermont.
body_markdown:
Last week, creators gathered in Stowe, Vermont, for Kando Trip 2026 – a celebration of our wonderful creative community. More than an opportunity to make images and share ideas, Kando Trip creates space for meaningful conversations between creators and Sony. The feedback, perspectives and inventive thinking shared throughout the event help inform future products, while the connections built foster greater understanding and trust. For both creators and Sony, Kando Trip is a valuable chance to collaborate, grow and shape a bright future together.


Photo by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 14mm f/1.8 G Master. 1/15-sec. f/6.3. ISO 320.


What is Kando? Kando is Sony’s core philosophy, which roughly translates into the power of emotional connection and serves as the foundation for the event.[Sony Artisan Tony Gale](https://www.instagram.com/tonygalephoto) has attended every Kando Trip, and this year he’s sharing what he was able to capture with us – as well as the gear he used to do it.


“The Sony Kando Trip is something I look forward to every year,” he says. “There is always tons of gear to borrow, but I still like to be as prepared as possible so I bring my own stuff when I can. Because Kando was in Vermont this year, I drove up from Connecticut and was able to bring more than I normally would.” Keep reading as Tony shares what was in his bag for another Kando Trip to remember.


Photography by Tony Gale


##### Shop This Kit:

Lenses:[14mm f/1.8 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel14f18gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[100mm f/2.8 Macro G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel100m28gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[28-70mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2870gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[50-150mm f/2 G Master,](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel50150gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)[400-800mm f//6.3-8 G](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel400800g?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


Accessories:[HVL-F60RM II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/all-accessories/p/hvlf60rm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[Sony TOUGH SD Cards](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/media/p/sfm128t-t1?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[Sony TOUGH CF-A Cards](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/media/p/ceag640t?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


#### Cameras


[Alpha 1 II:](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/all-interchangeable-lens-cameras/p/ilce1m2b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) A great flagship camera, high resolution and super fast.


####


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 1 II. 50-150mm f/2 G Master. 1/320-sec. f/2. ISO 100.


[Alpha 7R VI](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/full-frame/p/ilce7rm6b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=CamerasPage) : Such a fantastic camera, 67mp is incredible.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/500-sec. f/2. ISO 400.


[Alpha 9 III:](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/all-interchangeable-lens-cameras/p/ilce9m3b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=CamerasPage) The global shutter is magic, I use it with flash outdoors. I can overpower the sun with a Sony speedlite.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 9 III. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/2000-sec. f/3.2. ISO 250.


[RX100 VI:](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/compact-cameras/all-vlog-compact-cameras/p/dscrx100m7-b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) Wonderful pocket camera. I have been shooting selfies with people at the photo events I go to for many years with various iterations of it.


Photo by Tony Gale. RX100 VI. 1/200-sec. f/10. ISO 640.


[RX1R III](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/compact-cameras/all-vlog-compact-cameras/p/dscrx1rm3b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : My always in my bag camera, at Kando it was used for little moments.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/200-sec. f/7.1. ISO 160.


#### Lenses


[14mm f/1.8 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel14f18gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : Super wide, fast and sharp prime. I didn’t use it much on this trip but it is always a good tool to have at the ready.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 14mm f/1.8 G Master. 10-sec.


[100mm f/2.8 Macro G Master:](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel100m28gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) Amazingly sharp macro, also didn’t use much. Always good to have at the ready.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 14mm f/1.8 G Master. 1/8-sec. f/4. ISO 320.


[28-70mm f/2 G Master:](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2870gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) Super fast aperture mid range zoom, very sharp. Great for environmental portraits.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 9 III. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/3200-sec. f/2.8. ISO 250.


[50-150mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel50150gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : An absolutely amazing portrait lens, mid range to tight. Absolutely fantastic.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 7R VI. 50-150mm f/2 G Master. 1/200-sec. f/5. ISO 160.


[400-800mm f/6.3-8 G](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel400800g?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : Excellent reach and surprisingly light.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 1 II. 400-800mm f/6.3-8 G. 1/400-sec. f/8. ISO 3200.


#### Accessories


(3)[HVL-F60RM II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/all-accessories/p/hvlf60rm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : Sony speedlites, work like magic with the[Alpha 9 III](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/all-interchangeable-lens-cameras/p/ilce9m3b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) . The flashes and camera communicate with the flash/shutter timing to make it seamless at super high shutter speeds.


Tripod: Won this Leophoto tripod at photo trivia on the trip, and used it the next morning.


####


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 1 II. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 4-sec. f/11. ISO 100.


[Sony TOUGH SD Cards](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/media/p/sfm128t-t1?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : For the[RX1R III](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/compact-cameras/all-vlog-compact-cameras/p/dscrx1rm3b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) and[RX100 VI](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/compact-cameras/all-vlog-compact-cameras/p/dscrx100m7-b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) plus extras for the other cameras.


[Sony TOUGH CF-A Cards](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/media/p/ceag640t?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) : For the[Alpha 9 III](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/all-interchangeable-lens-cameras/p/ilce9m3b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) ,[Alpha 1 II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/all-interchangeable-lens-cameras/p/ilce1m2b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) and[Alpha 7R VI](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/interchangeable-lens-cameras/full-frame/p/ilce7rm6b?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) .


Think Tank Pixel Pocket Rocket Card Holder: The perfect card holder.


####


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 9 III. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/16000-sec. f/2. ISO 250.


Extra batteries: Always!


Strobe: I brought a bigger strobe as well.


Stands: For the strobe and speedlites.


Photography by Tony Gale. Alpha 9 III. 28-70mm f/2 G Master. 1/2000-sec. f/2.2. ISO 250.


Octabox: Modifier for the strobe.


Sand Bag: To keep the lights from blowing over.


Wagon: To haul everything around on the model shoots.
